email.subject: Lakeview Library — ceiling cleanup
email.body:
Hi,

Ridgeline Drywall left joint compound dust and offcuts above the ceiling in the Lakeview Library north wing. We need a separate cleanup crew before the ceiling closes. My cost estimate is twelve hundred dollars even.

Please open a back-charge to Ridgeline Drywall for that estimate. I'll confirm the final cost after the work is done.

Dana
